entries.german:
Hermann von Breitenlandenberg räumt dem Kloster St. Gallen das Wiederkaufsrecht ein für den obern und den niedern Hof in Stammheim.

Item vnd ainen brief, der geben ist anno domini M°CCC°XVIII°. Der selb brief wiset, dz her Herman von der Braiten Landenberg 1 ritter abt Herman vnd dem conuent ze sant Gallen 2 vor offem lantgericht in Turgo ew 3 fúr sich vnd sin erben den vollen gewalt vnd recht geben hât, also wenn er oder sin erben die kilchen ze Stamhain 4 ainest verlihent, dz denn dar nach daz gotzhus inwendig X iaren den na ehsten, wenn man wil, die ho ef ze Stamhain den obern vnd den nidern 4, mit lút vnd gu etern mit dem kilchensatz, der dar in geho ert, vnd mit allen rechten vnd zůgeho erden, alz er si von dem gotzhus ze sant Gallen erko vft vnd ze lehen enpfangen hât, von im oder sinen erben widerko vffen mag mit II c vnd XL mark silbers. Vnd wa er, ob dz gotzhus denselben widerkôf nit also in denselben X jaren ta etti, so so elti der egenant her Herman von Landenberg dem gotzhus vnuerzogenlich [in] ainem jar a) vff die vorgeschriben II c vnd XL mark silbers vmb die ho ef vss her geben so uil gůtz, alz sich denn her Eberhart von Búrglen 5, her Cůnr. von Ainwille 6 ritter vnd Eggloff von Rosenberg der elter 7 oder ander schidlút, die dar zů erkosen wurdint, ob dis dry oder iro dehainer abgiengi, bi iren trúwen vnd aiden erkennent, dz er nach hin geben so elli. Ta etti er oder sin erben dz aber nit also, wie dikk si dar an súmig wa erint, alz dik so so elti dz gotzhus allwegent aber X jar zil vnd frist haben, den widerko vff von inen ze tu ent in der wis, alz vor beschaiden ist. Vnd hett derselb her Herman gesworn, dz also ze haltent, vnd hett dar vmb zů im ze tro ester geben her Růdolfen von Landenberg sinen brůder 8, her Eglolfen von Roschach den júngern 9 vnd Eglolfen von Rosenberg den eltern, die och bi iren aiden dar vmb laisten sont, wenn si gemanot wurdint.
entries.english:
Hermann von Breitenlandenberg grants the monastery of St. Gallen the right of repurchase for the upper and lower court in Stammheim.

Item also a letter that was given in the year of our Lord 1318. The same letter shows that Herr Herman von der Breiten Landenberg 1 knight to Abbot Herman and the convent of St. Gallen 2 before an open land court in Thurgovia ew 3 for himself and his heirs has given the full power and right, thus when he or his heirs once enfeoff the church at Stamhain 4, that then thereafter the house of God within ten years at the nearest, when one wishes, the courts at Stamhain the upper and the lower 4, with people and goods with the church patronage that belongs to it, and with all rights and appurtenances, as he has redeemed them from the house of God of St. Gallen and received them in fief, may repurchase from him or his heirs with two hundred and forty marks of silver. And if, should the house of God not make this repurchase thus within the same ten years, then the aforementioned Herr Herman von Landenberg shall promptly [in] one year a) on the aforementioned two hundred and forty marks of silver for the courts give out as much goods, as then Herr Eberhart von Bürglen 5, Herr Conrad von Ainwille 6 knight and Eggloff von Rosenberg the elder 7 or other shield-men, who shall be chosen therefor, if these three or any one of them should fail, by their faith and oaths acknowledge that he thereafter gives so much. If he or his heirs do not do this thus, as often they are negligent in this, as often then the house of God shall always have ten years term and time, to repurchase from them in doing so in the manner, as previously described. And the same Herr Herman has sworn to hold thus, and has given for him as surety Herr Rudolf von Landenberg his brother 8, Herr Eglolf von Roschach the younger 9 and Eglolf von Rosenberg the elder, who also by their oaths shall stand for this, when they are summoned.
